newsitem.title: USA: Olsten stock rattled by Manpower earnings warning.
newsitem.headline: Olsten stock rattled by Manpower earnings warning.

text.p: The stock of temporary personnel supplier Olsten Corp. tumbled Wednesday, one day after the stock of Manpower Inc., the world's largest private employment agency, dropped sharply on its warning that this year's earnings will be less than expected.
Olsten lost $3.625 to $23 after hitting a 52-week low of $21.625 in heavy trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
Meanwhile, Manpower rebounded 50 cents to $30.875 on the NYSE after shedding $4.125 Tuesday on the company's warning that its 1996 profits would fall short of Wall Street's expectations.
